assets.name: 文档书页
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production cover artwork for a multimodal material library. The image MUST clearly depict recognizable stored media objects, not a generic abstract sculpture or architectural landscape.
Create one exceptionally beautiful premium editorial 3D still life. Wide horizontal 2:1 canvas. Opaque edge-to-edge background. The visible card crops to between 1.7:1 and 3.5:1, so the main subject must sit in the middle-height band and the right 55 percent of the frame. Fill the right 55 percent with a cohesive generous-scale group of media objects, central vertical 20–80 percent; important silhouettes and media cues must remain legible even in a small thumbnail. Left 40 percent is softly lit pale negative space for dark UI titles, integrated naturally with the seamless background. Three-quarter orthographic camera at a low elevated angle. Exquisite believable materials: warm ivory thick paper, satin ceramic, finely frosted tinted glass, restrained metal; fine rounded edges, beautiful contact shadows and soft directional studio lighting. Rich yet restrained color separation, elegant sculptural arrangement, real depth, carefully restrained tactile detail. Contemporary professional knowledge-workspace visual identity. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, interface screenshot, badges, border, cute characters, clutter, floating confetti or glitter. These are physical editorial representations of media, not flat app icons. No generic arches, islands, landscape background or decorative stone piles. Render ONE composition, no multi-panel grid.
Primary subject: a beautiful open ivory book with a fan of thick unprinted pages gently curling upward, accompanied by two neat loose document sheets tucked behind a slim translucent powder-blue document folder. The loose sheets have subtle embossed horizontal rules, not writing. A restrained blue ribbon bookmark threads through the book. The book and papers make one cohesive sculptural arrangement, distinctly recognizable as reading and document materials. Palette: icy powder blue backdrop, ivory pages, slate-blue folder edge and very small satin silver accent. Soft light emphasizes the layered page edges. No photos, musical objects or film.
